issue.title: Dropped hidden item remains hidden from room description
issue.description: Dropping an item that came from a hidden/container state can leave its hidden flag set, so the backend moves the item into the room while the room description still omits it.
issue.expected_behavior: A dropped item should be visible in the current room description after it leaves the player's inventory.
issue.observed_fault: An item that was previously hidden can remain hidden after being dropped, so the room state changes but the visible room description omits it.
reproduction: Go north to the corridor, then west to the bedroom.
Open the nightstand and take the small key.
Drop the small key in the bedroom.
Execute `look` and observe that the small key is missing from the room description.
issue.root_cause: `GameWorld.drop_item` updates the item's location but does not clear `item.hidden`, so previously hidden items remain invisible after being dropped.
